snippet.title: Detained: Too Good for School Trailer 2023
snippet.description:
Detained: Too Good for School Coming to Steam Early Access in 2024!
#arpg #brawler
🎮Wishlist on #Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394650/Detained_Too_Good_for_School/
💖Follow the dev O.T.K Games on Twitter: https://twitter.com/otkgames
💖Join the Discord: discord.gg/3PNWMC9

You play as a delinquent schoolgirl freshly liberated after half a year behind bars. Now the densely-populated metropolis of Swinster City lies sprawling before you. Fight for justice and become the city's savior, or join the criminal underworld and declare war on law and order.

Game Features
- Explosive Combat
- A Dynamic Storyline
- Incredible Gameplay Variety
- A Fully Interactive World
- Deep Relationships System
